about_the_game:
Welcome to Tango District — Where Control Is the Real Currency

Tango District is a cyberpunk city builder with a twist: it's a puzzle-driven strategy game where every building matters and every CEO wants something from you.

Spend limited funds to place buildings, increase your city’s score to unlock powerful new pieces, and complete shifting missions to earn income. As you build, corporations compete for influence — offering you deals, demands, and consequences. If you run out of money, one of them steps in… for a price.

Manage your city's growth, balance corporate interests, and navigate a dystopian simulation where economic survival is never guaranteed.

🔧 Gameplay Highlights

  • 🧠 Puzzle-driven city building
    Design with purpose — each placement affects score, resources, and future building options.

  • 💸 Dynamic mission economy
    Earn cash through objectives, manage your funds, and survive the ever-present risk of bankruptcy.

  • 🏢 Corporate "dating sim" dynamics
    Interact with powerful CEOs who will manipulate, reward, or betray you depending on your choices.

  • 🎮 Unlock progression system
    Reach milestones to unlock new building types and open new paths to expansion.

  • 🎯 Designed for replayability
    Every session brings new missions, layouts, and strategic decisions.

🎯 Perfect For Fans Of:

  • City-building sims with layers of strategy (Anno, Cities: Skylines)

  • Puzzle placement games (Islanders, Dorfromantik)

  • Cyberpunk settings with personality and narrative tension
